create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes then add arcs with labels and weights
test_graph_weights: test getting and setting graph arc weights as lists, numpy arrays, or raw pointers
test_graph_comparison: test comparing two graphs for equality or isomorphism using gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic
test_backward_autograd: test autograd by calling gtn.backward on the result of gtn.add to compute gradients on input graphs
test_parallel_ops: test parallel operations like gtn.negate and gtn.add on lists of graphs with backward pass
